sql.smsTeam.getAll: select st.*, (case when (select count(*) from flow.sms_team where archived = false and is_default is true and case when :isParent then st.company_id = any (select id from flow.company_hierarchy_filter_down(:parentCompanyId::int)) else st.company_id = :companyId end ) > 0 then true else false end) as defaultExists, coalesce(( SELECT array_to_json(array_agg(row_to_json(tb))) FROM ( SELECT stp.id, stp.position_id as "positionId", p.position as "name", stp.sms_team_id as "smsTeamId", stp.archived FROM flow.sms_team_position stp inner join flow.position p on stp.position_id = p.id WHERE stp.sms_team_id = st.id AND stp.archived is not true) tb), '[]') AS "positions", coalesce(( SELECT array_to_json(array_agg(row_to_json(tb))) FROM ( SELECT stu.id, stu.user_id as "userId", concat(u.first_name, ' ', u.last_name) as "name", stu.sms_team_id as "smsTeamId", stu.archived FROM flow.sms_team_user stu inner join flow."user" u on stu.user_id = u.id WHERE stu.sms_team_id = st.id AND stu.archived is not true) tb), '[]') AS "users", coalesce(( SELECT array_to_json(array_agg(row_to_json(tb))) FROM ( SELECT sto.id, sto.org_id as "orgId", o.org_name as "name", sto.sms_team_id as "smsTeamId", sto.archived FROM flow.sms_team_org sto inner join flow."org" o on sto.org_id = o.id WHERE sto.sms_team_id = st.id AND sto.archived is not true) tb), '[]') AS "orgs" from flow.sms_team st where case when :isParent then st.company_id = any (select id from flow.company_hierarchy_filter_down(:parentCompanyId::int)) else st.company_id = :companyId end and st.archived = false order by st.team_name asc
sql.smsTeam.getAllTeamUsers: select st.*, coalesce(( SELECT array_to_json(array_agg(row_to_json(tb))) FROM ( SELECT stu.id, stu.user_id as "userId", concat(u.first_name, ' ', u.last_name) as "name", concat(u.first_name, ' ', u.last_name) as "userName", stu.sms_team_id as "smsTeamId", stu.archived FROM flow.sms_team_user stu inner join flow."user" u on stu.user_id = u.id WHERE stu.sms_team_id = st.id AND stu.archived is not true union select null as id, upv.user_id, concat(upv.first_name, ' ', upv.last_name, ' - ', o.org_name) as name, concat(upv.first_name, ' ', upv.last_name) as userName, st.id as "smsTeamId", false as archived from flow.user_positions_vw upv inner join flow.org o on upv.org_id = o.id inner join flow.user_status_type ust on ust.id = upv.user_status_type_id and ust.company_id = :companyId where upv.archived is not true and upv.primary_flag is true and upv.org_id = any( array [ (select array_agg(org_id) from flow.sms_team_org sto where sto.sms_team_id = st.id and sto.archived = false) ]::integer[] ) and ust.user_status_type = 'Active' union select null as id, upv.user_id, concat(upv.first_name, ' ', upv.last_name, ' - ', p.position) as name, concat(upv.first_name, ' ', upv.last_name) as userName, st.id as "smsTeamId", false as archived from flow.user_positions_vw upv inner join flow.position p on upv.position_id = p.id inner join flow.user_status_type ust on ust.id = upv.user_status_type_id and ust.company_id = :companyId where upv.archived is not true and upv.primary_flag is true and p.id = any( array[ (select array_agg(position_id) from flow.sms_team_position stp where stp.sms_team_id = st.id and stp.archived = false) ]::integer[] ) and ust.user_status_type = 'Active' ) tb), '[]') AS "users" from flow.sms_team st where case when :isParent then st.company_id = any (select id from flow.company_hierarchy_filter_down(:parentCompanyId::int)) else st.company_id = :companyId end and st.archived = false;
sql.smsTeam.getTeamUsers: select st.*, coalesce(( SELECT array_to_json(array_agg(row_to_json(tb))) FROM ( SELECT stu.id, stu.user_id as "userId", concat(u.first_name, ' ', u.last_name) as "name", concat(u.first_name, ' ', u.last_name) as "userName", stu.sms_team_id as "smsTeamId", stu.archived FROM flow.sms_team_user stu inner join flow."user" u on stu.user_id = u.id WHERE stu.sms_team_id = st.id AND stu.archived is not true union select null as id, upv.user_id, concat(upv.first_name, ' ', upv.last_name, ' - ', o.org_name) as name, concat(upv.first_name, ' ', upv.last_name) as userName, st.id as "smsTeamId", false as archived from flow.user_positions_vw upv inner join flow.org o on upv.org_id = o.id inner join flow.user_status_type ust on ust.id = upv.user_status_type_id and ust.company_id = :companyId where upv.archived is not true and upv.primary_flag is true and upv.org_id = any( array [ (select array_agg(org_id) from flow.sms_team_org sto where sto.sms_team_id = st.id and sto.archived = false) ]::integer[] ) and ust.user_status_type = 'Active' union select null as id, upv.user_id, concat(upv.first_name, ' ', upv.last_name, ' - ', p.position) as name, concat(upv.first_name, ' ', upv.last_name) as userName, st.id as "smsTeamId", false as archived from flow.user_positions_vw upv inner join flow.position p on upv.position_id = p.id inner join flow.user_status_type ust on ust.id = upv.user_status_type_id and ust.company_id = :companyId where upv.archived is not true and upv.primary_flag is true and p.id = any( array[ (select array_agg(position_id) from flow.sms_team_position stp where stp.sms_team_id = st.id and stp.archived = false) ]::integer[] ) and ust.user_status_type = 'Active' ) tb), '[]') AS "users" from flow.sms_team st where st.archived = false and st.id = :id
sql.smsTeam.getDetails: select st.*, coalesce(( SELECT array_to_json(array_agg(row_to_json(tb))) FROM ( SELECT tpp.id, tpp.position_id as "positionId", p.position as "name", tpp.sms_team_id as "smsTeamId", tpp.archived FROM flow.sms_team_position tpp inner join flow.position p on tpp.position_id = p.id WHERE tpp.sms_team_id = st.id AND tpp.archived is not true) tb), '[]') AS "positions", coalesce(( SELECT array_to_json(array_agg(row_to_json(tb))) FROM ( SELECT stu.id, stu.user_id as "userId", concat(u.first_name, ' ', u.last_name) as "name", stu.sms_team_id as "smsTeamId", stu.archived FROM flow.sms_team_user stu inner join flow."user" u on stu.user_id = u.id WHERE stu.sms_team_id = st.id AND stu.archived is not true) tb), '[]') AS "users", coalesce(( SELECT array_to_json(array_agg(row_to_json(tb))) FROM ( SELECT sto.id, o.org_name as "name", sto.sms_team_id as "smsTeamId", sto.archived FROM flow.sms_team_org sto inner join flow."org" o on sto.org_id = o.id WHERE sto.sms_team_id = st.id AND sto.archived is not true) tb), '[]') AS "orgs" from flow.sms_team st where st.id = :id
sql.smsTeam.getTeamsForUser: select st.*, coalesce(( SELECT array_to_json(array_agg(row_to_json(tb))) FROM ( SELECT stu.id, stu.user_id as "userId", concat(u.first_name, ' ', u.last_name) as "name", concat(u.first_name, ' ', u.last_name) as "userName", stu.sms_team_id as "smsTeamId", stu.archived FROM flow.sms_team_user stu inner join flow."user" u on stu.user_id = u.id WHERE stu.sms_team_id = st.id AND stu.archived is not true AND u.id = :userId union select null as id, upv.user_id, concat(upv.first_name, ' ', upv.last_name, ' - ', o.org_name) as name, concat(upv.first_name, ' ', upv.last_name) as userName, st.id as "smsTeamId", false as archived from flow.user_positions_vw upv inner join flow.org o on upv.org_id = o.id inner join flow.user_status_type ust on ust.id = upv.user_status_type_id and ust.company_id = :companyId where upv.archived is not true and upv.primary_flag is true and upv.org_id = any( array [ (select array_agg(org_id) from flow.sms_team_org sto where sto.sms_team_id = st.id and sto.archived = false) ]::integer[] ) and ust.user_status_type = 'Active' and upv.user_id = :userId union select null as id, upv.user_id, concat(upv.first_name, ' ', upv.last_name, ' - ', p.position) as name, concat(upv.first_name, ' ', upv.last_name) as userName, st.id as "smsTeamId", false as archived from flow.user_positions_vw upv inner join flow.position p on upv.position_id = p.id inner join flow.user_status_type ust on ust.id = upv.user_status_type_id and ust.company_id = :companyId where upv.archived is not true and upv.primary_flag is true and p.id = any( array[ (select array_agg(position_id) from flow.sms_team_position stp where stp.sms_team_id = st.id and stp.archived = false) ]::integer[] ) and ust.user_status_type = 'Active' and upv.user_id = :userId ) tb), '[]') AS "users" from flow.sms_team st where case when :isParent then st.company_id = any (select id from flow.company_hierarchy_filter_down(:parentCompanyId::int)) else st.company_id = :companyId end and st.archived = false;
sql.smsTeam.getDefaultTeamId: select st.id from flow.sms_team st where case when :isParent then st.company_id = any (select id from flow.company_hierarchy_filter_down(:parentCompanyId::int)) else st.company_id = :companyId end and st.is_default is true;
sql.smsTeam.insertTeam: insert into flow.sms_team (team_name, company_id, created_by_id, date_created, modified_by_id, date_modified) values (:teamName, :companyId, :createdById, now(), :createdById, now())
sql.smsTeam.updateTeam: update flow.sms_team set team_name = :teamName, is_default = :isDefault, modified_by_id = :modifiedById, date_modified = now() where id = :id
sql.smsTeam.deleteTeam: update flow.sms_team set archived = true, is_default = false, modified_by_id = :modifiedById, date_modified = now() where id = :id
sql.smsTeam.getAssociatedProjectCountTeam: select count(*) from flow.project_message_team where sms_team_id = :teamId
sql.smsTeam.getPosition: select stp.*, p.position as "name" from flow.sms_team_position stp inner join flow.position p on p.id = stp.position_id where stp.id = :id
sql.smsTeam.addPosition: insert into flow.sms_team_position(position_id, sms_team_id, created_by_id, date_created, modified_by_id, date_modified) values (:positionId, :id, :createdById,now(),:createdById, now())
sql.smsTeam.deletePosition: update flow.sms_team_position set archived = true, date_modified = now(), modified_by_id = :modifiedById where position_id = :positionId and sms_team_id = :smsTeamId
sql.smsTeam.getUser: select stu.*, concat(u.first_name, ' ', u.last_name) as name from flow.sms_team_user stu inner join flow.user u on u.id = stu.user_id where stu.id = :id
sql.smsTeam.addUser: insert into flow.sms_team_user(user_id, sms_team_id, created_by_id, date_created, modified_by_id, date_modified) values (:userId, :id, :createdById, now(), :createdById, now())
sql.smsTeam.deleteUser: update flow.sms_team_user set archived = true, date_modified = now(), modified_by_id = :modifiedById where id = :teamUserId
sql.smsTeam.deleteUserByUserId: update flow.sms_team_user set archived = true, date_modified = now(), modified_by_id = :modifiedById where user_id = :userId
sql.smsTeam.getOrg: select sto.*, o.org_name as "name" from flow.sms_team_org sto inner join flow.org o on o.id = sto.org_id where sto.id = :id
sql.smsTeam.addOrg: insert into flow.sms_team_org(org_id, sms_team_id, created_by_id, date_created, modified_by_id, date_modified) values (:orgId, :id, :createdById, now(), :createdById, now())
sql.smsTeam.deleteOrg: update flow.sms_team_org set archived = true, date_modified = now(), modified_by_id = :modifiedById where org_id = :orgId and sms_team_id = :smsTeamId
